title: Tip Top Shape
description: We've covered a lot already, but I think it's time we get into the real interesting stuff. [Tips](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/tip_blueprint.png:124:62) are an upgrade that can be applied to most tools and weapons, giving them stat bonuses and occasionally new traits. Fer example, a diamond tip will bring the tool's harvest level up to Diamond tier while giving it the Brittle and Lustrous traits. Let's try making one now, shall we?
